extra: Orbit 0.2 beta: onboarding, stronger privacy defaults and family/school controls, on Firefox 157.
features: First-run onboarding: privacy promise, default browser, import, theme
HTTPS-only mode, strict tracking protection and fingerprinting protection by default
Encrypted DNS through Cloudflare Security (blocks known malware and phishing domains)
Safe-search default search engine; about:config blocked; uBlock Origin locked on
fixes: Fullscreen warning restored so pages cannot spoof the browser UI
knownIssues: HTTPS-only mode shows a warning page on sites without HTTPS; you can continue to the site from that page
Strict tracking protection can break some sites; use the shield icon to relax it per site
Encrypted DNS bypasses a network's own DNS filtering while Cloudflare is reachable
Beta builds are experimental, some features may be unstable

extra:
Welcome to the first beta release of Orbit Browser by SafeCircle.

Orbit is a privacy-focused browser built for families, schools, and privacy-conscious users, based on Mozilla Firefox.
features: uBlock Origin bundled as a built-in extension
Custom new tab background with Orbit branding
knownIssues: Beta builds are experimental — some features may be unstable
